title: Collections Note: The Unpaid-Fare Payment Amount and the Held-Out Amount (Wayfare Rides)
content:
The unpaid-fare payment amount on a fare charge of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** is the unpaid amount left on the fare charge less the held-out amount, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Unpaid amount left on the fare charge.** The payment failure booked against the fare charge less every settlement entry already booked against it.

**Held-out amount.** Found in three steps: first the review amount counted is taken; that dollar figure is then multiplied by the fare-basis share, by the payment-history factor and by the hold-out timing factor, each a fraction with no dollar amount added; the result is then limited to the hold-out cap and never exceeds the unpaid amount left on the fare charge.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Review amount counted | nil ($0.00) |
| Fare-basis share | 0.4 |
| Payment-history factor | 0.25 |
| Hold-out timing factor | 0.6 |
| Hold-out cap | $3.00 |

## The figures at each stage

| Stage | Figure |
|---|---|
| Unpaid amount left | payment failure less settlement entries already booked against the fare charge |
| Held-out amount | review amount counted, multiplied by 0.4, by 0.25 and by 0.6; then the lower of that, $3.00 and the unpaid amount left |
| Payment amount | unpaid amount left less held-out amount, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked examples (hypothetical charges)

*Nothing settled yet.* Payment failure $18.40 against the fare charge; no settlement entries. Unpaid amount left $18.40. Held-out amount: $0.00 multiplied by 0.4, 0.25 and 0.6 is $0.00. Payment amount **$18.40**.

*Earlier settlement entries on the charge.* Payment failure $27.40; settlement entries of $4.15 and $1.06 already booked against the fare charge. Unpaid amount left: $27.40 less $5.21 is $22.19. Held-out amount $0.00. Payment amount **$22.19**.
